description: SEO check for one page: whether search engines can index it (meta robots, X-Robots-Tag, robots.txt rules), title and meta description length, canonical URL, H1 headings, viewport, language, Open Graph tags, sitemap, HTTPS, and redirects, with a 0-100 score and a list of issues by severity. Useful for site audits and pre-launch checks. Not charged if the page can't be fetched. Paid via x402; see list_prices.

url.description: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL of the page to audit.
